newsitem.title: LATVIA: AGENCY OFFERS RIGA CARRIAGE, TWO OTHERS.
newsitem.headline: AGENCY OFFERS RIGA CARRIAGE, TWO OTHERS.

text.p: The privatisation agency said on Thursday that it is to offer shares in Riga Carriage Works, Ogre Knitwear and Riga Model Tipograph in a public offer from July 21 to August 15.
Some 26.38 percent or 1.4 million shares will be offered in Riga Carriage Works, 19.45 percent or 1.6 million shares in Ogre and 42.24 percent or just over 900,000 shares in Tipograph.
Riga Carriage Works has been in existence since 1895 and had a net turnover in 1996 of 11.5 million lats and loss of 3.5 million lats.
Ogre was created in 1969 and last year had turnover of 16.6 million lats and a profit of 8,751 lats.
Riga Tipography started life in 1920 and had turnover in 1996 of 1.4 million lats for a 1,000 lat profit.
